about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a Full Stack Developer building end-to-end applications with Python/Django and React/TypeScript. With a background in Industrial Process Engineering, I combine analytical thinking with technical skills to build scalable and efficient web solutions.
about.creator: Experience Creator

story.paragraph1: I started my career as an Industrial Process Engineer, where I learned to optimize complex systems, analyze bottlenecks, and find efficient solutions to structural problems.
story.paragraph2: I brought that same analytical mindset into software development. Today I'm a Full Stack Developer, building end-to-end applications with Python/Django on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend.
story.paragraph3: I integrate AI Agents into my workflow to optimize architecture and accelerate deliveries, without losing focus on the fundamentals: clean code, testing, and good design practices.

inventory.title: Inventory System | Full-Stack Management

booking.description: Residential amenities reservation platform with role-based access control (Admin/Resident), real-time search, automated notifications, Cloudinary asset storage, and PostgreSQL on Render.
